# SmartLoad Solution

> RPM calculator and load-decision tool for expediters driving cargo vans, sprinters, and box trucks. Calculates real RPM including deadhead miles and expenses so drivers can decide whether to accept, reject, or negotiate a load.

SmartLoad Solution is a web app (with a free Starter plan) built for owner-operators and expediters. Core features: real-time RPM calculator, an AI assistant (Lex) for load recommendations, a profitable-zones map by state, a monthly financial dashboard, and full load history.
